comment: One-sided exploratory gates on all six completed unfiltered near-server captures, measured identically to candidates. Limit = max + spreadAllowance * max(max-minus-min spread, spreadFloor or 0). The fixed report rule selects the smallest common allowance in {0.5, 1, 2} passing every official capture against the other five: 1. False-reject control is only that LOO check over six captures; batch drift was observed. No population error-rate guarantee, independent held-out validation, confidence interval or renderer equivalence. At least 100 samples per metric; lower values permitted. See research/fidelity/2026-10-26-server-timing-references/REPORT.md.

anchor_receipt_p50.comment: Typical stock-client interpolation reset correction, in world units. Includes network and collector timing. Use every eligible unfiltered capture in the default six-batch corpus; receipt-derived values have no header-resolution spread floor.

anchor_receipt_p95.comment: Tail correction magnitude with the common LOO-selected spread allowance, without a spread floor. Correlated anchor windows are not independent trials; false-reject control is only the six-capture LOO check with observed batch drift.

frame_server_p50.comment: Median elapsed-ms header interval. Only this metric uses a 1 ms spread floor: the server header has 1 ms resolution, so its integer quantile cannot express spread finer than one header unit. Without it the five 7 ms medians reject the sole 8 ms capture at every multiplier. The floor does not apply to receipt-derived metrics.

delay_p90.comment: Receipt-minus-server excess over a centered +/-600-frame minimum, unfiltered for both reference and candidate. Later batch-3 delay quantiles exceed batches 1-2; false-reject control is only the six-capture LOO check. Masked development/held-out summaries remain server characterization, not the default gate. No spread floor or absolute latency inference.

viewMatched.comment: Provisional engineering screening bounds, declared before replaying #144 with this gate. Not fitted to the sparse-view table or calibrated for false-reject probability. Each candidate/reference capture pair must satisfy every exposed bin and the same candidate-exposure mixture. No pooling across captures, no sparse waiver; <=9 ms is diagnostic only. See docs/research-workflow.md#transport-parity.

minimumSeconds.comment: At least 30 active server seconds per bin in each capture, to reject momentary view visits. Engineering admission minimum, not independent sample size or a confidence guarantee.

minimumWholeWindows.comment: At least 20 complete stable server-second windows per bin per capture. Requires sustained support for emission rate, and retains fully silent windows. Not fitted from observed pass/fail outcomes.

emissionRate.comment: Two-sided whole-window mean frames/s difference <= max(2 frames/s, 20% of reference). Provisional material-regression screen, not an empirical official tolerance or fidelity claim. Applied to each bin and the fixed candidate-exposure mixture.

meanPeers.comment: Time-weighted cached peers; allow half a peer or 10% of reference to bound within-bin workload differences.

ownSpeed.comment: Mean decoded speed within 1 protocol speed unit; time-weighted per own/peer snake-second. Bounds declared independently of #144.

ownFast.comment: Absolute fraction difference <= 0.10 (10 percentage points). Fast is speed >9, boost proxy >=13.9, turning is wanted/heading separation > one angle byte; no boost command or turn direction is inferred.

ownBoost.comment: Absolute fraction difference <= 0.10 (10 percentage points). Fast is speed >9, boost proxy >=13.9, turning is wanted/heading separation > one angle byte; no boost command or turn direction is inferred.

ownTurning.comment: Absolute fraction difference <= 0.10 (10 percentage points). Fast is speed >9, boost proxy >=13.9, turning is wanted/heading separation > one angle byte; no boost command or turn direction is inferred.

ownSegments.comment: Mean cached body anchors within max(5, 25% of reference), to screen size-related activity differences; not a geometry/physics validation.

ownAnchorsPerSnakeSecond.comment: Decoded reports per own/peer snake-second within max(0.5, 25% of reference). Anchors count events; mass includes standalone, tail and growth-anchor mass; turn counts wanted-angle changes. Provisional workload screen.
